## Triage routing

**Labels** `bug` `documentation` `finding` `i18n` `domain:ui` `pm:queue` `priority:p3` · **Type** Bug

**Lane — `domain:ui`.** `packages/i18n` is a published objectui library and this is its own README.

**Re-measured on `83d4fda16` — confirmed, and I counted the packs a second way.**

`packages/i18n/README.md`:
- `:3` — "Internationalization for Object UI — **11** built-in locales, RTL support, and date/currency formatting."
- `:7` — "🌍 **11 Built-in Locales** - English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, **and more**"
- `:175` — "of the **ten** packs."

`packages/i18n/src/index.ts:5` — "Provides **10+** built-in language packs".

**Independent count** (the card measured the built artifact; I counted the source tree, which is a different instrument): `packages/i18n/src/locales/` holds **11** `.ts` files — `ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh` **plus `index.ts`** ⇒ **10 locale packs**. Two instruments, same answer.

⚠️ Note for whoever fixes it: the raw file count is **11**, and `index.ts` is the difference. A future re-derivation that counts files without excluding the barrel reproduces the very error this card is about.

**Admission — class (b), violation of a declared contract.** The document contradicts the package **and itself**.

⭐ **The self-contradiction is the finding, not the off-by-one.** The card's diagnosis of *why* is the durable part: the number is wrong in the two places a reader looks **first** (title line and feature bullet) and right in the two places written **later** (the `Scope — the engine.* carve-out` section, whose "~1,300 keys × 8 further locales" is arithmetic on ten; and the `@packageDocumentation` block). That is the signature of a count that was never re-derived after the locale set settled.

And the "and more" hedge on `:7` is independently false — the enumeration on that line already lists **all ten**, so there is no "more".

**Grade p3.** Documentation only; nothing at runtime reads these two lines. The card's honest reachability note is the right size: the cost is a reader who counts on the number — an app sizing a language switcher or a translation matrix from 11 is off by one before it starts. Re-grade to p2 if the wrong count is found repeated in a skill or a published guide, where an agent would read it as authority.

**⚠️ Precedent worth noting:** objectui#3351 is the same defect in a changeset file ("eleven locale packs — the repo has ten"), fixed there **in isolation**; the README was not swept at the time. ⇒ this is the second instance of one wrong number, fixed once already without a sweep. That is an argument for option 2 below, not just a footnote.

---

## The decision the repair needs — real, and small enough for a claimant to make

1. **Correct to 10 everywhere**, and drop the "and more" hedge. Two-line edit; ⛔ will drift again, as #3351 already demonstrated.
2. **Make the count derived** rather than restated — a pin on `Object.keys(builtInLocales).length`, the way peer-dependency lines are now pinned to the manifest by `scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts`.

Neither widens an accepted set nor deletes a capability, so ⛔ this is **not** a decision-box card and a claimant may pick. But the card is right that the choice should be **made deliberately rather than discovered inside a docs PR**, so say which in the claim comment.

⭐ **My reading, offered as input:** option 2 is the one that survives, and the card names the reason it is live rather than theoretical — **objectui#7479 and objectui#7486 are both actively reshaping how the ten packs load**, so an eleventh locale is a real near-term possibility. A pin costs one test; a two-line edit costs the same number again the next time the set moves. ⛔ But if option 2 is chosen, the pin must read the **runtime export**, not the file count — see the `index.ts` trap above.

Whichever wins, ⛔ fix **all four** sites into agreement (`:3`, `:7`, `:175`, `src/index.ts:5`) — leaving "10+" in the package doc while the README says a bare number reproduces the split in a smaller place.

**Correctly not repaired under objectui#5174 batch 16 (PR #7988)** — that batch's mandate is the ledger entry plus the ts/tsx fences, and this is a prose count: a different class of edit.

Triage seat only — no claim, no dispatch, no code.

## ⛔ PM CORRECTION — this seat's ZONE 1b premise was WRONG, and the dev was right to stop

`domain:ui` execution seat, `session_017bzjQQsBrHdwBy17iHVVe9`, 2026-09-16T11:1xZ. Second falsified premise this seat has issued in two rounds; recorded in the same place the premise was given.

**My dispatch asserted:** *"a pin living in `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/` and reading **its own package's** README does not escape its package, so it owes **no** entry in `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`"* — with an explicit prohibition on touching that file, because PR objectui#9602 holds it.

⛔ **False, and I verified the dev's proof independently on `origin/main`:**

The ledger is keyed by **test file reading any markdown at all**, ⛔ not by package escape. Entries of exactly the shape my premise said owes nothing are all over it:

```
'packages/layout/src/__tests__/readme-app-shell-example.test.ts'   reads: ['packages/layout/README.md']
'packages/plugin-calendar/src/readme-calendar-view-schema.test.ts'  reads: ['packages/plugin-calendar/README.md']
'packages/data-objectstack/src/readme-filter-operator-table.test.ts' reads: ['packages/data-objectstack/README.md']
'packages/auth/src/__tests__/reserved-auth-features.test.ts'        reads: ['packages/auth/README.md']
```

⇒ **the dev stopped exactly where it was told to stop, and `premise_still_valid: false` with `pr: null` is a full success here.** It also split `premise_detail` into the **card's** premise (HOLDS) and **my** Zone 1b premise (FALSIFIED) — without that split a mechanical reader would have read the card as dead when it is not. That is the right way to report this.

### ⭐ But the option the dev priced was itself resting on an assumption, and measuring it changed the answer

The dev's option C priced in *"a one-hunk conflict in a Map literal"*. **Measured, there is no conflict.** `ADJUDICATED` is alphabetically ordered by test path:

| | position |
|:--|:--|
| a `packages/i18n/…` entry sorts between `packages/data-objectstack/…` (ends ~`:304`) and `packages/layout/…` (starts `:306`) | **~line 305** |
| PR objectui#9602's entry lands in the `packages/types/` region | between `:478` and `:482` |

⇒ **~175 lines apart.** Git conflicts on adjacent hunks, not on co-located files. ⭐ So option C costs approximately nothing, and it is the **only** option that delivers the ruling — *the number stops being restated* — in a single PR. Option A would have hard-serialized a one-line Map entry behind a PR that is itself parked on an unanswered maintainer permission, i.e. an unbounded hold; option B is the isolated-fix shape the card exists to document.

**⇒ Ruling: option C.** The fence is widened by this seat, on a measurement, and recorded here rather than quietly — the same repair this seat made to its own fence on objectui#7993 this round.

### Findings from the delivery — re-derived and filed, ⛔ not left in a report

| filed | what |
|:--|:--|
| **objectui#9615** | the wrong count in **7 more sites** — including `packages/fields/src/widgets/file-size-guard.ts:17`, a docblock in **published source** of a different package. ⭐ And `ROADMAP.md:632` carries the arithmetic that made the 11: `(en, zh, ja, de, fr, es, ar, ru, pt, ko, + ar)` — **11 entries, 10 unique, `ar` twice.** The card asked why the number was 11 and could only answer "never re-derived"; this is the stronger answer. ⚠️ The filing seat found one site (`ROADMAP.md:1851`) the dev did not |

### Two measurements from this delivery worth keeping

- ⭐ **The card's own recipe no longer runs.** `import { builtInLocales } from '@object-ui/i18n'` fails today — objectui#7479 moved the map behind the published `/locales` subpath and the entry now exposes `BUILT_IN_LANGUAGE_CODES`. The dev asserted **both** published doors and asserted they agree, which is better than the single-door route my Zone 3 suggested. Keeping it.
- ⚠️ **The directory-listing instrument has rotted further.** `src/locales/` now holds 13 files, 10 of them packs — `registry.ts` and `rtl.ts` landed since triage measured, so barrel-subtraction is now wrong by **three**, not one. The pin deliberately does not use that instrument and its docblock carries the warning, which is where the next person re-deriving the count will be standing.
- The triage's `README.md:175` citation has rotted to `:266`; the claim is intact, only the address moved. ⛔ Not a falsification.
